title: Murmuring Mollusk
statement: A small, round cuttlefish hovers in deep teal water, turning a single smooth pebble over and over with two careful tentacles while its skin ripples through soft, slow colours like half-finished sentences. It rarely moves from its chosen spot, but if you watch long enough, you'll see it pause mid-turn, one large eye fixed on nothing in particular, as though it has just thought of something it needs to reconsider.
